content.title: [Brand] 1.7L Electric Kettle, 304 Stainless Steel, Auto Shut-Off, 1500W
bullets: 304 STAINLESS STEEL INTERIOR: The inner pot is made of 304 stainless steel, so water heats in a sturdy, easy-to-rinse metal interior. The lid and handle are PP plastic for a lightweight, comfortable grip.
AUTO SHUT-OFF & BOIL-DRY PROTECTION: The kettle switches off automatically once the water boils. If it is turned on with too little or no water, boil-dry protection cuts the power.
360° SWIVEL BASE: Lift the kettle off the base and set it back from any angle. This works the same for right- and left-handed users and makes it easy to grab from any side of the counter.

CONCEALED HEATING ELEMENT, EASY TO CLEAN: The heating element sits hidden beneath a flat stainless steel floor. There is no exposed coil to scrub around, so you can simply wipe and rinse the interior.

1.7L CAPACITY, 1500W POWER: Holds up to 1.7 liters, enough for several mugs of tea, coffee, oatmeal, or instant noodles in one batch. It runs on standard US 120V/60Hz outlets at 1500W. In our in-house testing, a full 1.7L boiled in about 5 minutes. This is not a third-party test result, and actual time varies with water temperature and volume.
content.description:
Hot water for tea, pour-over coffee, oatmeal, or instant soup is ready with the press of a switch. This 1.7L electric kettle has a 304 stainless steel inner pot and runs at 1500W on standard 120V US outlets, so it fits easily into your morning routine.

The kettle turns itself off when the water boils, and boil-dry protection shuts off power if it is switched on without enough water. The 360° swivel base lets you lift the kettle off and set it back down from any direction. The heating element is concealed under a flat stainless steel floor, so cleanup is just a quick wipe and rinse.

The lightweight PP plastic lid and handle make pouring easy, and the 1.7L capacity lets you fill several mugs at once. In our in-house testing (not a third-party report), a full kettle boiled in about 5 minutes. Actual boil time depends on starting water temperature and fill level.

content.notes_zh: 标题按 AMZ-01 控制在 75 字符以内（共 71 字符），无促销词或特殊符号。没有 UL/ETL/NOM/FDA 认证、未做 BPA/LFGB 检测，所以不写 BPA-free、food-grade certified 或任何认证宣称。5 分钟烧开明确标注为工厂内部测试、非第三方报告。不写 eco-friendly、Made in USA、价格或库存。Prop 65 是否需要警示须由供应商检测资料确认后再决定是否加警示。

findings.problem_zh: 商品页没有加州 65 号提案警示，也没有标明 WARNING 的链接。供应商资料没有说明本产品（304 不锈钢内胆、PP 塑料盖与把手、电器线材等）是否需要 Prop 65 警示，也没有提供任何化学物质检测信息，所以无法判断是否必须加警示。该产品在 Amazon 美国站销售，可能发往加州，存在合规风险。
findings.suggestion_zh: 请人工向工厂确认：产品各部件（含电源线、PP 塑料件、密封圈等）是否含有 Prop 65 清单物质（如 DEHP 等邻苯类、铅），并索取相关检测报告。如需警示，在商品页加入完整警示，或加一个标明 WARNING 的链接。警示需包含 WARNING:、具体化学物质名称、危害类型（癌症或生殖毒性）以及 www.P65Warnings.ca.gov。如确认不需要，请保留书面依据。不得自行编造化学物质名称。

content.hook: ¿Sigues calentando el agua en la olla para tu cafecito? Mira lo que encontré 👀

script.shot_zh: 早上的厨房，手拿起电热水壶在水龙头下接水，镜头带到壶身。
script.line: Le caben 1.7 litros, o sea, alcanza para el café de toda la familia de una sola vez.

script.shot_zh: 打开壶盖，特写内胆和平整的底部。
script.line: Por dentro es de acero inoxidable 304 y la resistencia va escondida, entonces limpiarlo está facilísimo, nada de batallar.

script.shot_zh: 把壶从底座上拿起，再从不同角度放回去，底座旋转演示。
script.line: La base gira 360°, lo agarras y lo pones como te acomode, seas zurdo o derecho.

script.shot_zh: 水烧开，开关'咔'一声自动弹起，特写指示灯熄灭。
script.line: Cuando hierve se apaga solito, y si se queda sin agua también se apaga. Ya no tienes que estar al pendiente.

script.shot_zh: 往杯里倒热水冲咖啡/泡茶，冒热气，镜头转向创作者。
script.line: Es de 127V, lo conectas en el contacto de tu casa y listo. Si lo quieres, dale al carrito aquí abajito.

content.caption: Adiós a calentar el agua en la olla 🙌 Hervidor eléctrico de 1.7 L con interior de acero inoxidable 304, apagado automático, protección contra hervido en seco y base giratoria 360°. 1500W, 127V 60Hz. En pruebas internas del fabricante hierve 1.7 L en unos 5 minutos aprox. ☕ Ideal para tu cafecito, tecito o sopita instantánea. Lo encuentras en el carrito 🛒
content.notes_zh: 用'cafecito/no batallar/estar al pendiente'等墨西哥口语以日常泡咖啡场景种草，只写资料内的容量、304内胆、隐藏发热盘、360°底座、自动断电和干烧保护及127V/1500W；5分钟烧开注明为工厂内部测试，未提NOM/UL/BPA等未持有认证或检测，无绝对化用语和站外引流。
